name: ongeul-local-translator
description: 브라우저 안에서 번역하고 읽어주는 한국어 Chrome 확장 프로그램

scripts.test:extension: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built
scripts.test:extension:model: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:model
scripts.test:extension:model:m2m100: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:model:m2m100
scripts.test:extension:model:m2m100:wasm: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:model:m2m100:wasm
scripts.test:extension:model:small100: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:model:small100
scripts.test:extension:tts: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:tts
scripts.test:extension:page-tts: npm run build && npm run test:extension:built:page-tts
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run verify && npm run test:extension:built && npm run test:extension:built:tts && npm run test:extension:built:page-tts && npm run test:extension:built:model:m2m100:wasm && npm run test:extension:built:model:small100 && npm audit --omit=dev
